# Metrix Realty Group

Metrix Realty Group provides property appraisal and valuation services from offices in London and Windsor, Ontario. The firm has served clients since 1995. Its team includes AACI- and CRA-designated appraisers. Contact the firm to confirm availability, scope, timing, fees, and whether a particular lender will accept a proposed report.

## Contact and locations

- Website: https://metrixrealty.com/
- Contact and consultation: https://metrixrealty.com/contact

- Email: info@metrixrealty.com
- London office details: https://metrixrealty.com/contact
- Windsor office: 2557 Dougall Ave #6, Windsor, ON N8X 1T5
- Office hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
